name: Restaurants
description: Restaurant menu and ordering links resolved from each venue's own website

openstreetmap.purpose: Provides the venue's official website tag used to find menu, first-party order, and explicitly linked provider-order pages
openstreetmap.dataSent: No request is made to OpenStreetMap. The OpenMapX server makes one robots-aware, byte-capped request to the contributed venue website (plus its robots.txt) and sends only normal HTTP request metadata. It does not submit forms or crawl provider sites.
